title: Pooled feature store: one feature registry (name, source, window, lag, venue), one as-of join library, a leakage test that refuses a forward-shifted column, read by ENTRY v2, BRACKETS and HOLD/ADJUST/CLOSE
note: Filed 2026-11-01 by lane ML-FEATURE-INFRA from docs/research/ml-feature-inventory-2026-11-01.md (gap G2, ranked plan section 4). WHY: ENTRY re-implements 20 OHLCV features inline in scripts/research/ml_decision_entry.py because the pooled 60-symbol path has no shared store; ml/datasets/families/market_features.py has a 108-column per-symbol schema but is per-timeframe, trainer-resident, BTC-only for funding/OI and order flow, and writes 0.0 for an absent side-stream (collapsed state). BUILD: a registry-driven builder that emits families 1-5 of the plan (taker flow, basis/funding, positioning, cross-sectional context, OHLCV shape) from the ML-FS-ARCHIVE store; missing = NaN plus a <family>_present flag; each feature is one function imported by builder and serve path; tests: forward-shifted column refused, byte-identical rebuild, per-family coverage report per symbol. No sizing and no risk features. Does NOT change ENTRY v1. DONE WHEN: a build over the 60-symbol dev window prints per-family present percentage and the leakage test fails on a planted lead. Gates: none.

observation.what: the store builds for the 60-symbol dev window with a per-family coverage table and the planted-lead test fails as designed
